verdict: Google Business Profile went dark across all three locations nine days ago.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, Google Business Profile was the sole active channel this period — paid advertising has not run at any location. All three listings recorded zero actions for the nine days ending September 8, after combining for 330 total GBP actions in the 28-day window, which points to a shared listing or visibility issue rather than isolated incidents. Search clicks are also falling sharply at Forte and O'Hare, reinforcing that organic presence is under pressure right now. We are actively investigating the root cause of the GBP outage and the connected web/SEO issue, and a contact list for outreach is being finalized so an email and calling pipeline can launch and partially offset lost inbound activity. Once the listing issue is resolved, GBP engagement should return to prior levels; outreach sequences are targeted to go live by end of September.
